dct_description_sm: This data set was acquired in order to validate actual remote sensing algorithms and develop new ones to measure chlorophyll concentration, colored dissolved organic matter concentration and suspended matter concentration over the Canadian Arctic region. This is necessary because optical properties are affected by large freshwater fluxes in the Beaufort Sea and Hudson Bay which contaminates the remote sensing signal. In the eastern portion (archipelago and Baffin Bay), it is believed that phytoplankton species have different light absorption capacities than in more southern waters thus again affecting the ability of remote sensing instruments to correctly measure phytoplankton biomass.
dct_title_s: Inherent and apparent optical properties in the Canadian Arctic
